text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
We're here at last!
I'm so super-duper-ultra
excited for summer camp!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Buuut...
this isn't just time to jump for joy!
Isn't that right, Trainer?

Right... While summer camp is our chance
to train, there's also a
special event
happening this year.

There's a race that follows the road from
the beach all the way to
camp... And
Kawakami Princess has entered to run.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I even thought all about the most
important things from the movie! Today
we've got to show off the true bond
between a princess and
her prince!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Princ...
text_block_list.text:
Well, well, I thought I smelled a
commoner. It's the same smell of cheap
noodles that, unlike authentic ramen, will
live out their life in
anonymity!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Ah, it's you! Dark Princ—ahem—I mean,
the bully from before!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Princ...
text_block_list.text: Heh... I suppose you hope to join the race today? I wouldn't recommend it, since I'll be participating.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Princ...
text_block_list.text:
Heh heh heh... I'm sure even you
understand now. You'll never win
against a
real princess, so why don't you just slink
off—

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Never! There's no way I'll back down from
this battle! As a fighting
princess, I'll be
there, with my prince by my side!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Princ...
text_block_list.text:
Hmph! You just don't learn, but have it
your way... I'll simply have to
crush you
underfoot this time!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
To be honest, I can't really compare to
her. I might hate it, but I saw
the truth
when we raced.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Still...
I won't run away from this! I have to
win! We have to combine
our powers to
defeat her, 'kay?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
So we need to start strategizing right
away! First things first...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
A name for our battle plan! I'm thinking
either, "The Princess and Prince's Big
Banquet" or "The Power of Two - Winds of
Victory!"
Which one do you like?

After our strategy meeting, the day gets
even hotter, leading into the
fiery race
we've prepped for!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Pant... Pant... Hyaaah!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Princ...
text_block_list.text:
Well, look at you! All that confidence,
only to get worn out so soon!

text_block_list.name: Student Caster
text_block_list.text:
We're past the midpoint! The hot summer
sun must be taking a toll on
their stamina!
Who will pull ahead?!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Princ...
text_block_list.text: Pant... Pant... Hehehe! Make way for a real princess! Raaaaagh!

Someone in the back is sprinting all the
way to the lead... It's Dark
Princess!

text_block_list.name: Student Caster
text_block_list.text:
They're almost at the finish line!
It looks
like first place is going
to—hold on!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: HIIIYAAAAAH!

text_block_list.name: Student Caster
text_block_list.text:
Kawakami's pulled away from the pack!
That's one big burst of speed!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Princ...
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! But she was exhausted. Where's that
power coming from?!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Hraaagh! Princess Acceleration... times a
trillion!

text_block_list.name: Student Caster
text_block_list.text:
Kawakami's caught up to the lead right
before the finish! Who will
claim the win?!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Princ...
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant... You don't know who you're messing with! Victory goes to... the true—

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
It goes to the princess with a true bond!
And that's MEEE!

text_block_list.name: Student Caster
text_block_list.text:
Finish! First place goes to...
Kawakami! She
won by a nose!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Hah! I did it! Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Princ...
text_block_list.text:
N-no... This can't beee! How...
How could I
lose?!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I saw through your trick. You're good at
charging ahead from the
back during the
last leg.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Princ...
text_block_list.text: What did you say?!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I did lose to you once,
so my trainer found
out all about you.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
That's why our plan was to wait until you
went full strength, then I'd
dish out all my
power at once and return the favor! It's
called...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"Princess Power Times a Trillion -
Demolish
Dark Princess with Our
True Bond!"
Catchy, huh?!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Still though,
we put all that work into our
strategy, but it was a close
one! You really
are a tough enemy!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Princ...
text_block_list.text:
Hmph... I don't need your pathetic
consolations!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Come on, we're not enemies anymore since
the race is over! That's a
Princess Fighter
promise! From today on, we're friendly
rivals!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Princ...
text_block_list.text:
Hah, you like Princess Fighter? I stopped
watching that years ago.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
What?! I knew it—you're a Princess Fighter
fan too! Cause all your
lines were just like
Dark Princess!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Princ...
text_block_list.text:
E-enough of that! You're totally wrong! I
only watched it when I ate
instant noodles
at snack time...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Yes, yes, yesss! This is a victory for the
powerful bond between a
princess and her
prince!

It's just us on the moonlit beach, and
Kawakami Princess is filled with
glee after
her big win.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I forgot,
Trainer! There's something I really
wanted to try if I won! Can
we?!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, okay, here it is! Um... You
remember the last part of the
movie? I
want to recreate it with the two of us!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! On their way home after saving
Earth, the princess and prince
have a
heart-to-heart on the moon!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Let's see... Ahem! O-okay, here I go!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"Prince... We did it... We saved the
planet."

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"But this isn't the end.
Everyone's waiting
for us back on Earth!"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"No matter the battle, I will overcome it!
Because I... I am with my one
and only
prince!"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Aaaah! The bond between them really is
special!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: (And the prince of my destiny... is right here in front of me!)

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Heehee! With the power of our bond,
we're going to perform the
greatest
miracles the world's ever seen!
